svg.title: Kalimantan at dusk: rainforest, oil palm and a burning edge, watched from orbit
svg.desc: A wide view across a river valley in Kalimantan. On the left bank the rainforest still stands; on the right, an oil palm plantation stretches to the horizon. Along the boundary a line of peat fire glows, and a tall smoke plume bends with the wind into the haze, turning the setting sun red. An orangutan sits on a branch in the foreground watching, while a radar satellite passes high above.
